description: Read files with 80% token reduction through intelligent caching, diff-based updates, and syntax-aware optimization

chunkIndex.description: For chunked files, the chunk index to retrieve

chunkSize.description: Size of chunks for large files (default: 4000)

diffMode.description: Return only diff if file was previously read (default: true)

enableCache.description: Reuse a cached read of this file when it has not changed

encoding.description: File encoding used to read the file

includeMetadata.description: Include size, hash and encoding alongside the content

maxSize.description: Maximum content size to return in bytes (default: 100000)

path.description: Path to the file to read

preserveStructure.description: Keep structural lines (signatures, exports) when compressing output

name: smart_read
